notes: Texts read from sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (card images) on 2026-11-20 and from unmatched-memory: they agree. Character card 318 on sheet 3 (10x7, index 18).
1v1 reading: 'your opponent' is the only rival; Patroclus 'defeated' is the engine's `alive: false`.

ability.text:
When Patroclus is defeated, discard 2 random cards.

While Patroclus is defeated:
- Add +2 to the value of all Achilles' attacks.
- If Achilles wins combat, draw 1 card.
ability.notes: Trigger: the instant Patroclus falls (in a combat, by an effect, by exhaustion) Achilles' owner discards 2 cards of the hand at random (fewer if they hold fewer). While he is defeated: +2 to every attack Achilles plays (attack cards and versatile cards played as attack, as Hellboy's ANUNG) and the owner draws 1 after each combat Achilles wins (the hero's own AFTER runs for every combat the owner played a card in; flagged `cardless` it also runs when Achilles defends with no card, flagged `second_attack` it also runs in the combat of a second attack he makes: Ivan 2026-11-20).

cards.title: Achilles' Heel
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: If you lost the combat, your opponent gains 1 action.
cards.notes: Defense 4 / boost 2, Achilles only. 'Lost' is 'did not win' (a defender wins ties).

cards.title: Feint
cards.text: IMMEDIATELY: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Brothers In Arms
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: If Patroclus is not defeated, gain 1 action.
cards.notes: Attack 4 / boost 2, ANY. Patroclus is checked when the AFTER runs (he may have fallen in this very combat).

cards.title: Under Achilles' Helm
cards.text: IMMEDIATELY: If Patroclus is not defeated, Achilles may swap spaces with him. If he does, Patroclus is now the defender.
cards.notes: Defense 2 / boost 4, Achilles only (so `this` is Achilles), the mirror of Luke Cage's Got My Back?. Both alive: they swap spaces (anywhere on the board, no range); if they did, Patroclus takes the place of Achilles in this combat as the defender, with this card in play for him: the attacker's card is aimed at Patroclus from now on (damage and the AFTER effects too).

cards.title: Skirmish
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: If you won the combat, choose one of the fighters in the combat and move them up to 2 spaces.
cards.notes: Versatile 4 / boost 1, ANY. The same effect as Bigfoot's, Eredin's and Tomoe Gozen's card.

cards.title: Test For Weakness
cards.notes: Attack 1 / boost 3, ANY. A DOUBLE ATTACK (Battle of Legends, Volume Two): the first part is a plain attack 1; RELENTLESS ASSAULT (3 ATK) is the second attack, an AFTER effect (docs/effects-dsl.md section 45), so Feint stops it and a Skirmish does not. The mechanic belongs to the double-attack engine, not to this file. Whether Achilles' +2 applies to the second attack is Pending Ivan (docs/heroes/achilles.md).

cards.title: Battle Frenzy
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Deal 2 damage to both fighters in the combat.
cards.notes: Attack 3 / boost 2, Patroclus only. Both fighters of the combat, the player's own included (a defeated one is not there any more).

cards.title: Spear Throw
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to an opposing fighter in Achilles' zone.
cards.notes: Scheme (boost 1), Achilles only. Any opposing fighter in a zone of Achilles' space; with several the owner chooses. With no one there the scheme is played for nothing.

cards.title: The Day of Your Doom
cards.text: DURING COMBAT: You may deal 2 damage to Patroclus. If you do, the value of this attack is 5 instead.
cards.notes: Attack 3 / boost 2, Patroclus only. The 2 damage is the price of an `optional`. Patroclus can die of it: Achilles then discards 2 random cards and gets the +2 and the draw from then on. `set_value` 5: bonuses stay (Patroclus has none).

cards.title: Wily Fighting
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter adjacent to your fighter.
cards.notes: Versatile 3 / boost 1, ANY. 'Your fighter' is the one that played the card; each adjacent opposing fighter, the combat's own opponent included.

cards.title: Battle Hardened
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Choose a card in your discard pile and return it to your hand.
cards.notes: Versatile 2 / boost 2, ANY. Any card of the owner's own discard pile.

cards.title: Blessed By Hermes
cards.text: AFTER COMBAT: Move each of your fighters up to 3 spaces. They may move through opposing fighters.
cards.notes: Versatile 3 / boost 1, ANY. Achilles and Patroclus (if alive), up to 3 each, through opposing fighters.

plugins.why: Under Achilles' Helm: after the swap Patroclus takes Achilles' place in the combat as the defender. Luke Cage's and Houdini's mechanism (CombatFlow.replace_combatant); no op changes who is in the combat.

hidden_info.what: discard 2 random cards from the owner's own hand
hidden_info.bot_rule: The bot's hand is the engine's; for the human the engine draws the positions from the hand size and the human gives those cards up, the bot never reads the hand.
